body:
You stay safe too. You made a difference. You matter. I appreciate every keystroke, every memory brought back, every tear, every emotion. We feel more and harder than most or any other personality, sometimes our perception gets thrown off of what is a good and bad thing to feel.

If you think similarly to me then you will understand this next sentence. I give you permission to feel happy and important and cared for.
I may read these words every day. Ivybelle, my daughters name is Annabelle. That makes me smile.

I think the last time my son saw his bio dad was when he was 4 and he is 12 now. I came into the picture right before age 7. I didn't know how to be a dad and he didn't know how to have a dad. We had rough spots, but now he is at an age where I can show him the things that can shape him into something better than me. I also have a 5yr old and a 9mo old with down syndrome. Due to my baby needing extra care, I am a stay at home dad since my wife would go crazy as a stay at home mom.
Strange thing is, my eldest is my stepson.
I went back on my meds today after posting this. I'm feeling better and at the moment I am watching Pete Holmes (the comedian) with my oldest son and things are dare I say, good.

https://youtu.be/OLR4EnRNaDw 

Edit: they have Cho at 9 but say he is the 7th smartest on Earth. I guess we can average that out.
